display.purpose: Page headline (landing hero); closing headline uses the same voice up to 4rem.

command-word.purpose: A spoken command set in its --cmd-* colour.

group-label.purpose: SectionLabel: uppercase name of a group of items inside the app; not placed above headlines.

editor-ui.purpose: Geist, loaded only in the editor v2 chunk (--ed-font).

editor-mono.purpose: Geist Mono, editor only (--ed-mono): timecodes, numbers.

shadows.name: shadow-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary calls to action and focused hero elements only.

shadows.name: ambient-glow
shadows.value: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 50% at 50% 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.22), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 35% at 90% 15%, rgba(236,72,153,0.12), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 30% at 10% 20%, rgba(139,92,246,0.10), transparent 70%)
shadows.purpose: Fixed body::before glow behind every page; the only place magenta appears on its own surface, always paired with violet.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one curve for entries and state transitions (landing --ease-out).

motion.name: phase-fade
motion.value: phase-fade-in 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) backwards; from opacity 0, translateY(8px)
motion.purpose: Screen and phase entry. Fill-mode backwards so no transform lingers to trap fixed dialogs.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button and toggle press feedback (the cleanup's restore toggles 0.94).

motion.name: step-chip
motion.purpose: Narration chips entering per demo step.

motion.name: step-collapse
motion.purpose: A marked strip piece collapses out; transitions run only between step-machine steps, never during holds.

motion.name: step-rise
motion.value: transform 560ms ease-out; lies at perspective(60rem) rotateX(80deg) on the tape end, stands up to 0
motion.purpose: The finished 9:16 clip stands up; caption pops in at 240ms.

motion.name: step-sweep
motion.purpose: The recording playhead sweep at the start of each loop.

motion.name: reveal-once
motion.purpose: One-time in-view demos (reframe pan, sentence cleanup).

motion.name: bar-show-hide
motion.value: show 220 to 240ms, hide 160 to 200ms ease-out, visibility delayed on hide
motion.purpose: Header pill CTA and phone bottom bar appearing when the hero button is gone.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: phase-fade, skeleton, pulse-dot stop; landing transitions drop to none, the take strip shows one still frame with removed pieces hatched; loops also stop off screen and in hidden tabs and go on from where they were.

components.name: Tint Button
components.description: Secondary action next to a primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-tint { border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 1.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--brand-strong, #ddd6fe); background: var(--brand-tint, rgba(139,92,246,0.12)); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-tint:hover { background: rgba(139,92,246,0.2); } .ds-btn-tint:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-hover, #a78bfa); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A panel on the page: surface-1, hairline border, 16px corners.
components.html:
Your video is ready

Captions burned in, 1080p, 9:16.

narrative.overview:
A dark, quiet edit bay at night. Surfaces are near-black with a slight violet undertone, layered from page to card to elevated by lightness, with a soft ambient violet and magenta glow fixed behind the page. Into that calm, colour enters for exactly two reasons: violet marks the one thing to do (the action, focus, the link), and five fixed hues name the spoken commands. Everything else is neutral, so a coloured word always means something.

Type is the system font, set heavy and tight for headlines and plain for reading; the site ships no web font. The editor alone loads Geist and Geist Mono. Caption fonts (Bangers, Montserrat, Poppins, Playfair, Inter) belong to the video, never to the interface. Motion is quick and calm: one ease-out curve, short steps, no bounce, and every animation has a reduced-motion answer.
keyCharacteristics: Dark UI only (`color-scheme: dark`); no light theme, no pure black, no cold zinc.
Depth by lighter surface and hairline border, not heavy shadow.
Violet for action and focus; magenta only as violet's gradient partner.
Fixed command colours wherever a "Cleo …" command appears.
System font on the site; Geist only in the editor; Bangers only in captions and share images.

One ease-out curve, UI steps of 150 to 600 ms, reduced motion respected everywhere. The one exception is a playhead (the take strip's recording sweep, the clip's scrub): it moves at the speed of time, linear.

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Violet is spent on actions, links, focus and active states. One primary (brand-solid) action per view; on the landing the header and phone bar carry it only while the hero and closing buttons are off screen.

rules.name: The Fixed Command Rule
rules.body: Each "Cleo …" command always wears its own `--cmd-*` colour, as text, chip border, marker post or tint, and nothing else uses those hues as decoration. Never swap them. Commands are written in the language's quotation marks and never translated.

rules.name: The Caption Data Rule
rules.body: Caption preset colours (yellow, neon green, cyan and so on from `web/src/lib/captions/presets.ts`) and their black strokes and drop shadows are video data rendered inside caption frames, not UI colours or UI shadows.

rules.name: The No Web Font Rule
rules.body: Site pages load no UI web font. Geist lives only in the editor; Bangers only in the Clipper caption style and share images; caption fonts load only inside caption frames.

rules.name: The Language Rule
rules.body: Headlines break by phrase in Japanese (`word-break: auto-phrase`) and keep words whole in Korean (`keep-all`); every string ships in all 14 languages.

rules.name: The Lighter-Surface Rule
rules.body: To raise something, make its surface lighter and give it a hairline; do not reach for a bigger shadow.

dos: Do use the CSS variables from `globals.css`, never raw hex, in UI components.
Do fill every filled brand button with `brand-solid` and white text, `brand-solid-hover` on hover.
Do colour every spoken command with its `--cmd-*` token, in quotation marks.
Do raise surfaces by lightness (surface-0 to 1 to 2) plus a 1px border.
Do enter screens with `phase-fade` (280ms, `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, 8px rise) and use the same curve for every transition.

Do give every new animation a `prefers-reduced-motion` rule; looping demos stop off screen and in hidden tabs, go on from where they were, and show one still frame under reduced motion. The landing has no pause buttons (owner, Oct 2026).
Do focus with a 2px `brand-hover` outline at 3px offset.
donts: Don't use `brand` (#8b5cf6) as a fill behind white text (4.23:1).
Don't use magenta as a standalone button, text or fill colour.
Don't swap, reuse or decorate with the command colours.
Don't load a web font on site pages, or use Geist outside the editor or Bangers outside captions and share images.
Don't add a light theme, pure black, cold zinc greys, or a text colour dimmer than `text-faint`.
Don't use emoji or unicode glyphs as UI icons; use lucide through `ui/Icon`.
Don't carry caption styling (black text stroke, hard drop shadows, preset colours) into UI elements.
Don't use bouncy easing or long hero animations.
